name: ValidationMessage
summary: Inline or summary validation message. Variants: error, warning, success, info. Pairs with Field (inline error/hint) and Form (top-of-form summary). Pulls icon + color + role from one source.

variant.description: Inline lives below a single Field; summary lives at the top of a Form on submit failure.

title.description: Headline for the summary variant (e.g., 'Fix 3 errors before continuing').

children.description: Anchor links for summary variant; inline error string for inline.

id.description: Used by aria-describedby on the related Field.

icon.description: Override the default icon. Default is variant-driven.

keyboard: Tab — into the summary; anchor links navigate to the offending Field
rules: tone='error' sets role='alert' (or aria-live='assertive' for the summary variant on submit).
Color is never the only signal — every variant ships with an icon AND text.
Summary variant focuses itself on submit failure so screen readers announce immediately.

do: Use 'inline' for per-field errors below the Field.
Use 'summary' at the top of a Form on submit failure with anchor links to each invalid Field.
Pair the icon + color + text — color alone is never the signal.
Skip success state by default in operator UI; reserve for explicit post-validation moments (saved, sent).
dont: Don't use 'error' tone for warnings — warning tone exists for a reason.
Don't set aria-live='assertive' for inline messages — only the summary on submit.
Don't render two ValidationMessages per Field — error and hint are mutually exclusive.

changelog.note: Initial dedicated contract. Was previously a buried atom inside feedback.tsx; promoted because it's a form composition primitive, not a feedback affordance.
